title: OpenJoystickDriver service listener failure
description: The file beside the service's RPC socket (the socket path plus '.failure.json') that the service writes when its request listener stops on a fatal error. A successful listener start and an orderly stop delete it. 'ojd status' and 'ojd diagnose' read it when the service cannot be reached.

code.description: The error code that explains the stop to the user.

errno.description: The error number of the failed accept or poll call.

time.description: When the listener stopped, in UTC and whole seconds.

pid.description: The process that wrote the file. Readers report the failure only while this process runs: a process with this identifier and the start time below.

pidStartSeconds.description: Whole seconds of the start time of the process pid, as the system reports it (since the Unix epoch).
